$comment: Source of truth for Zita V2 merchant-owned metafield definitions. Documented in docs/architecture/metafield-definitions.md. Checked and provisioned by scripts/metafields/provision.mjs, which only creates missing definitions and pins/unpins them to reach the Admin display order. The order of each owner type's array IS the Admin display order, top to bottom.

PRODUCT.name: Artwork width
PRODUCT.description: Width of the artwork itself, not the frame or packaging. Shown with the height, e.g. 12 × 16 in.

PRODUCT.name: Artwork height
PRODUCT.description: Height of the artwork itself, not the frame or packaging. Shown with the width, e.g. 12 × 16 in.

PRODUCT.name: Ready to hang
PRODUCT.description: Turn on when the artwork arrives ready to hang.

PRODUCT.name: Certificate notes
PRODUCT.description: Certificate of authenticity note, e.g. Certificate of authenticity included.

PRODUCT.name: Artwork story
PRODUCT.description: The story behind this artwork, shown on the artwork page.

COLLECTION.name: Editorial eyebrow
COLLECTION.description: Small label shown above the editorial statement, for example “From the Studio”.

COLLECTION.name: Editorial text
COLLECTION.description: Main editorial text for this collection. Adding text enables the editorial band.

COLLECTION.name: Editorial image
COLLECTION.description: Optional studio, process, context, or featured image shown in the editorial band.

COLLECTION.name: Editorial link label
COLLECTION.description: Optional call-to-action text, for example “About Ranjeeta” or “Explore the Series”.

COLLECTION.name: Editorial link
COLLECTION.description: Destination for the editorial text link. Use a relative storefront path such as /pages/about or a full external URL.

COLLECTION.name: Editorial product
COLLECTION.description: Optional featured artwork. When selected, the editorial image links to this product.

COLLECTION.name: Editorial position
COLLECTION.description: Choose where the editorial band appears in the collection sequence.

excluded.reason: Sold state is derived from inventory and availability, never a manual flag.
custom.editorial_text is the presence trigger for the band.
Only one approved band treatment exists. The snippet has a variant parameter for later.
